name: US CFTC Commitments of Traders
summary: Weekly Commitments of Traders futures and options positioning (Legacy, Disaggregated, TFF, Supplemental) from the CFTC Public Reporting Environment.

app_token.description: optional Socrata application token for publicreporting.cftc.gov; without one, calls share a per-IP pool and may get 429s. Sent in the X-App-Token header.

notes: Free and keyless. The portal is a Socrata site: each dataset is queried with SoQL parameters ($where, $select, $order, $limit, $offset, $q).

Common columns: report_date_as_yyyy_mm_dd (the as-of date of the positions), market_and_exchange_names, contract_market_name, cftc_contract_market_code, commodity_name, open_interest_all; the position columns differ by report.
Values come back as JSON strings, numbers included.
Default $limit is 1,000 rows; add an $order when paging with $offset.
Each report family has a futures-only and a futures-and-options-combined dataset; pick the dataset id in the path.

endpoints.name: Query the Commitments of Traders Legacy report
endpoints.summary: Positions split into commercial, non-commercial and non-reportable traders, by exchange. One row per contract market per weekly report.

dataset.description: Dataset id: 6dca-aqww = futures only; jun7-fc8e = futures and options combined.

where.description: SoQL filter. Strings in single quotes; dates as ISO timestamps.

select.description: Comma-separated columns to return, or aggregates like count(*).

order.description: Sort, e.g. 'report_date_as_yyyy_mm_dd DESC'. Set one whenever paging, so pages are stable.

q.description: Full-text search across the row's text columns.
